fullPassage:
Traditionally, fishers went out to sea with fishing nets or long lines on boats to catch fish. They took advantage of their experience gained through trial and error, through observation, and through knowledge passed down from previous generations. With wild fish stocks gradually declining due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of casting nets or lines. In fact, according to a UN report, about 49% of the fish consumed worldwide in 2020 came from fish farms, not from the wild. This figure is expected to continue to grow, increasing to 62% by 2030. With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by artificial intelligence (AI), fish farmers are able to provide healthy, affordable seafood to families everywhere.
An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers' ability to detect and prevent sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and profitability. One of the most modern methods to do this is through the power of computer vision and precision sensors, allowing fish farmers to identify and track diseases before they spread. An aquaculture system equipped with high-precision underwater tools has already been developed in Norway. It can hold up to 150,000 salmon in a sea cage, regularly inducing each fish into a tube where high-resolution cameras and sensors record everything about each individual salmon, including their overall shapes and dot patterns, their weight and growth rate, as well as any signs of sea lice, physical wounds, or abnormalities. Every detail is registered in the fish's health record, along with millions of images and figures. Such huge amounts of data and other information are taken care of by the AI system.
A computer system with deep learning capabilities is able to track and record fish behavior better than humans can, especially when the system is trained with enough relevant data. It can distinguish and identify one fish from another and diagnose whether a small speck is dirt or sea lice, and this information is entered into the fish's health record. In a sense, the fish farm is monitored by an AI doctor on duty 24/7. Farmers can then determine when they should take action, such as when to separate an abnormal group from the rest or spread out the fish population to reduce density, without resorting to harsh chemical treatments, which can harm the fish, the environment, and even the consumer. In addition, all this data from cameras and sensors can be utilized for various applications and purposes.
One of the most noticeable and effective applications is real-time monitoring of fish behavior and other environmental changes, which serves multiple purposes, including diagnosing diseases in individual fish. By processing large sets of data, an AI system can detect and recognize unusual group behaviors of an entire school of fish, possibly caused by changes in water quality, temperature, or oxygen levels surrounding the cage. It can also ensure the quality of cage nets to prevent fish from escaping or predators from invading and protect the surrounding habitat.
The system can also tell farmers exactly when to feed the fish by identifying patterns of behavior that an individual fish or the school exhibits when they are hungry. This is how farmers can accurately determine optimal feeding times and amounts. The right amount of food at the right time minimizes cost, reduces waste and pollution, and maximizes fish growth rates. Given the fact that feeding constitutes more than 50% of a fish farm's operational budget, this precise feeding approach will ultimately contribute to a more affordable supply of fish for consumers as well as efficient and sustainable aquaculture operations in general.
AI continues to advance in aquaculture to extend beyond caged fish. In particular, smart fish farming technologies can be applied to seaweed farming. Seaweed is as valuable a source of food as fish. It's also a source of fuel and an important ingredient for cosmetics, fertilizers, and other medicinal and industrial products. As such, ongoing research is exploring various ways AI can help in the seaweed industry, including the use of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and swarm robotics. Using cameras and sensors, AUVs can do many of the analytical and diagnostic tasks on seaweed farms. Swarm robots, or many small robots working together, can swim in and around seaweed farms to collect data and then make decisions on how to deal with problems that arise. Single larger robots or even humans may be available to take care of the physical labor from removing harmful weeds to harvesting; however, swarm robots may be more efficient and cost-effective.
The potential of AI in aquaculture is vast, and it brings a more sustainable and technologically driven future for fish and seaweed farming. Families that gather together, eagerly anticipating a healthy seafood dinner, may not be aware of the carefully monitored fish and seaweed farms or the cutting-edge AI technology involved in getting food to their table. However, the process of doing so is evidence of the considerable amount of investment in sustainable, high-quality aquaculture with AI. With AI as an ally, the future of the oceans and the nourishment of humanity is just a little bit more secure.

questions.passage: With wild fish stocks gradually (A)[declining / growing] due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of casting nets or lines. This figure is expected to continue to (B)[grow / decrease], increasing to 62% by 2030. With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by AI, fish farmers are able to provide healthy, (C)[affordable / expensive] seafood to families everywhere.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 야생 어류 자원이 감소(declining), 수치가 계속 증가(grow), 적당한 가격의(affordable) 해산물.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ declining–grow–affordable: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① increasing은 B에 부적합(원문 grow)
❌ ② growing(A)은 declining의 반대
❌ ④ expensive는 affordable의 반대
det.tip: declining(감소하는) ↔ growing / affordable(적당한 가격의) ↔ expensive

questions.passage: An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers' ability to (A)[detect / create] and prevent sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and profitability. One of the most modern methods to do this is through the power of computer vision and precision sensors, allowing fish farmers to (B)[identify / ignore] and track diseases before they (C)[spread / contain].
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 바다 이를 감지(detect)하고, 질병을 확인(identify)하고, 퍼지기 전에(spread).
det.analysis:
✅ ① detect–identify–spread: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② ignore(무시)는 identify의 반대
❌ ③ create(만들다)는 detect와 반대
❌ ④ contain(억제하다)은 spread(퍼지다)와 반대
det.tip: detect(감지) / identify(확인) / before they spread(퍼지기 전에)

questions.passage: The potential of AI in aquaculture is vast, and it brings a more (A)[sustainable / wasteful] and technologically driven future for fish and seaweed farming. Families may not be aware of the (B)[cutting-edge / outdated] AI technology involved in getting food to their table. With AI as an (C)[ally / enemy], the future of the oceans and the nourishment of humanity is just a little bit more secure.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 더 지속 가능한(sustainable) 미래, 최첨단(cutting-edge) AI 기술, AI를 협력자(ally)로 삼아.
det.analysis:
✅ ② sustainable–cutting-edge–ally: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① enemy(적)은 ally(협력자)의 반의어
❌ ③ wasteful(낭비적인)은 sustainable의 반의어
❌ ④ outdated(구식의)는 cutting-edge의 반의어
det.tip: sustainable(지속 가능한) ↔ wasteful / cutting-edge(최첨단) ↔ outdated / ally(협력자) ↔ enemy

questions.passage: Traditionally, fishers went out to sea with fishing nets or long lines on boats to catch fish. They took advantage of their experience ①<u>gained</u> through trial and error, through observation, and through knowledge ②<u>passed</u> down from previous generations. With wild fish stocks gradually ③<u>declining</u> due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of casting nets or lines. With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by AI, fish farmers are able to provide healthy, ④<u>costly</u> seafood to families everywhere.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④비싼(costly) → 원문은 적당한 가격의(affordable).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ costly → affordable: AI 기술로 '적당한 가격의' 해산물 제공이 목적
❌ ① gained(얻은): 경험 적합
❌ ② passed(전해진): 지식 전달 적합
❌ ③ declining(감소하는): 어류 자원 감소 적합
det.tip: affordable(적당한 가격의) ↔ costly(비싼)

questions.passage: A computer system with deep learning capabilities is able to track and record fish behavior better than humans can. It can ①<u>distinguish</u> and identify one fish from another and ②<u>diagnose</u> whether a small speck is dirt or sea lice. In a sense, the fish farm is monitored by an AI doctor on duty 24/7. Farmers can then determine when they should take action, without ③<u>resorting</u> to gentle chemical treatments, which can harm the fish, the environment, and even the ④<u>consumer</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③온화한(gentle) 화학 처리 → 원문은 강한(harsh) 화학 처리.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ gentle → harsh: '강한' 화학 처리가 해를 끼칠 수 있어 사용하지 않는다는 맥락
❌ ① distinguish(구별하다): 적합
❌ ② diagnose(진단하다): 적합
❌ ④ consumer(소비자): 적합
det.tip: harsh(강한, 거친) ↔ gentle(온화한, 부드러운) / resorting to = ~에 의지하다

questions.passage: The system can also tell farmers exactly when to feed the fish by identifying patterns of behavior. The right amount of food at the right time ①<u>minimizes</u> cost, reduces waste and pollution, and ②<u>minimizes</u> fish growth rates. Given the fact that feeding constitutes more than 50% of a fish farm's ③<u>operational</u> budget, this precise feeding approach will ultimately ④<u>contribute</u> to a more affordable supply of fish.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ②어류 성장률을 최소화(minimizes) → 원문은 최대화(maximizes).
det.analysis:
✅ ② minimizes → maximizes: 적절한 먹이는 성장률을 '최대화'해야 함
❌ ① minimizes(최소화): 비용 최소화 적합
❌ ③ operational(운영의): 운영 예산 적합
❌ ④ contribute(기여하다): 적합
det.tip: maximizes(최대화하다) ↔ minimizes(최소화하다) / growth rates = 성장률

questions.passage: Traditionally, fishers went out to sea with fishing nets or long lines on boats to catch fish. With wild fish stocks gradually declining due to overfishing, more fishers are turning to farming instead. The potential of AI in __________ is vast, and it brings a more sustainable and technologically driven future for fish and seaweed farming. With AI as an ally, the future of the oceans is more secure.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI의 수산 양식(aquaculture) 분야에서의 잠재력은 매우 크다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② aquaculture(수산 양식): 글 전체의 주제
❌ ① entertainment(오락): 무관
❌ ③ transportation(운송): 무관
❌ ④ construction(건설): 무관
det.tip: aquaculture = 수산 양식 / aqua(물) + culture(재배)

questions.passage: Traditionally, fishers went out to sea with fishing nets or long lines on boats to catch fish. With wild fish stocks gradually declining due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming. An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers's ability to detect and prevent sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and __________. One of the most modern methods to do this is through the power of computer vision and precision sensors, allowing fish farmers to identify and track diseases before they spread. An aquaculture system equipped with high-precision underwater tools has already been developed in Norway.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 바다 이는 어류 건강과 수익성(profitability)에 큰 위협이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ profitability(수익성): 바다 이가 건강과 수익 모두 위협
❌ ① entertainment: 무관
❌ ② decoration: 무관
❌ ③ destruction: 위협의 결과이지 위협 대상 아님
det.tip: profitability = 수익성 / threat to health and profitability = 건강과 수익성에 대한 위협

questions.passage: AI continues to advance in aquaculture to extend beyond caged fish. In particular, smart fish farming technologies can be applied to seaweed farming. The potential of AI in aquaculture is vast, and it brings a more __________ and technologically driven future for fish and seaweed farming. Families may not be aware of the carefully monitored fish and seaweed farms or the cutting-edge AI technology involved in getting food to their table. However, the process is evidence of the considerable amount of investment in high-quality aquaculture with AI.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI는 더 지속 가능한(sustainable) 미래를 가져온다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① sustainable(지속 가능한): 환경 보호+효율적 운영 = 지속 가능
❌ ② temporary(일시적인): 반대
❌ ③ harmful(해로운): 긍정적 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ declining(감소하는): 무관
det.tip: sustainable = 지속 가능한 / sustainable aquaculture = 지속 가능한 수산 양식

questions.passage: Every detail is registered in the fish's health record, along with millions of images and figures. Such <u>huge</u> amounts of data and other information are taken care of by the AI system.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 huge와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 방대한(huge) 양의 데이터.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ enormous(막대한): huge ≈ enormous
❌ ① tiny(극히 작은): 반의어
❌ ② narrow(좁은): 무관
❌ ④ moderate(적당한): 방대함과 다름
det.tip: huge ≈ enormous ≈ vast ≈ immense = 막대한, 방대한

questions.passage: Farmers can then determine when they should take action, without resorting to harsh chemical treatments. In addition, all this data from cameras and sensors can be <u>utilized</u> for various applications and purposes.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 utilized와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 데이터가 다양한 용도로 활용될(utilized) 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② use(사용하다): utilized ≈ used
❌ ① ignore(무시하다): 반의어
❌ ③ discard(버리다): 반의어
❌ ④ collect(수집하다): 활용과 다른 단계
det.tip: utilize ≈ use ≈ employ = 활용하다, 사용하다

questions.passage: The right amount of food at the right time minimizes cost, reduces waste and pollution, and maximizes fish growth rates. Given the fact that feeding <u>constitutes</u> more than 50% of a fish farm's operational budget, this precise approach is crucial.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 constitutes와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 먹이가 운영 예산의 50% 이상을 차지한다(constitutes).
det.analysis:
✅ ① makes up(차지하다): constitutes ≈ makes up
❌ ② eliminates(제거하다): 무관
❌ ③ reduces(줄이다): 무관
❌ ④ prevents(막다): 무관
det.tip: constitute ≈ make up ≈ account for = ~을 차지하다

questions.passage: With wild fish stocks gradually <u>declining</u> due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of casting nets or lines.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 declining과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 감소하는(declining)의 반의어.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ improving(개선되는): declining(감소/악화)의 반의어
❌ ① increasing(증가하는): 부분적 반의어이나 improving이 더 포괄적
❌ ② rising(상승하는): 유사
❌ ③ growing(성장하는): 유사
det.tip: declining(감소/쇠퇴하는) ↔ improving(개선되는) / fish stocks declining = 어류 자원 감소

questions.passage: Farmers can then determine when they should take action, without resorting to <u>harsh</u> chemical treatments, which can harm the fish, the environment, and even the consumer.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 harsh와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 강한(harsh)의 반의어.
det.analysis:
✅ ② gentle(부드러운): harsh의 정반대
❌ ① advanced(발전된): 무관
❌ ③ strong(강한): 동의어
❌ ④ effective(효과적인): 무관
det.tip: harsh(강한, 거친) ↔ gentle(온화한, 부드러운)

questions.passage:
(A) Every detail is registered in the fish's health <u>record</u>, along with millions of images and figures.

(B) Farmers can then determine when they should take action, without <u>resorting</u> to harsh chemical treatments, which can harm the fish.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 record와 resorting의 의미로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 건강 기록(record)에 등록. (B) 강한 화학 처리에 의지하지(resorting) 않고.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 기록–의지하다: (A) record=기록(명사), (B) resorting to=~에 의지하다
❌ ① ②④ 의미 조합 부정확
det.tip: record(명사)=기록 / resort to=~에 의지하다 (resort=휴양지 의미도 있으나 여기서는 동사)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어는?
"able to continue over a period of time without causing damage to the environment"

det.korean: 환경에 해를 끼치지 않으면서 일정 기간 지속될 수 있는 → 지속 가능한(sustainable).
det.analysis:
✅ ① sustainable: 영영 풀이와 정확히 일치
❌ ② profitable(수익성 있는): 환경 아닌 수익
❌ ③ efficient(효율적인): 지속성과 다름
❌ ④ affordable(적당한 가격의): 무관
det.tip: sustainable = 지속 가능한 / sustain(유지하다) + -able

questions.passage: In fact, according to a UN report, about 49% of the fish __________ (consume) worldwide in 2020 came from fish farms, not from the wild. This figure is expected to continue to grow, increasing to 62% by 2030.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 전 세계적으로 소비된(consumed) 물고기의 약 49%.
det.analysis: fish + consumed(과거분사) = 소비된 물고기. 수동 후치수식.
det.tip: consume(소비하다) → consumed(소비된) / fish consumed worldwide = 전 세계적으로 소비된 물고기

questions.passage: An aquaculture system __________ (equip) with high-precision underwater tools has already been developed in Norway. It can hold up to 150,000 salmon in a sea cage.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 고정밀 수중 도구가 장착된(equipped) 수산 양식 시스템.
det.analysis: system + equipped(과거분사) with = ~이 장착된 시스템. 수동 후치수식.
det.tip: equip(장착하다) → equipped(장착된) / equipped with = ~이 장착된

releasing fish into the wild ocean
minimizing cost and maximizing fish growth rates
reducing the number of fish farms worldwide
questions.passage: The system can also tell farmers exactly when to feed the fish by identifying patterns of behavior. This is how farmers can accurately determine optimal feeding times and amounts. The right amount of food at the right time achieves the goal of __________. Given the fact that feeding constitutes more than 50% of a fish farm's operational budget, this precise approach is crucial.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 적절한 시기의 적절한 양의 먹이는 비용 최소화와 어류 성장률 최대화 목표를 달성한다.
det.analysis:

❌ ① chemical treatments: 사용하지 않는 방법
❌ ② release into wild: 양식과 반대
❌ ④ reduce farms: 언급 없음
det.tip: optimal feeding = 최적 급여 → minimize cost + maximize growth

ch: replacing all human workers in fish farms
eliminating all types of seafood from diets
increasing the use of chemical pesticides in farming
questions.passage: With wild fish stocks gradually declining due to overfishing, more fishers are turning to farming. AI technology helps detect diseases, optimize feeding, and monitor environments. The right amount of food at the right time minimizes cost and maximizes growth. This precise feeding approach will ultimately contribute to a more affordable supply of fish for consumers as well as __________.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소비자에게 적당한 가격의 어류 공급뿐만 아니라 효율적이고 지속 가능한 수산 양식 운영에도 기여.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ efficient and sustainable aquaculture: 원문 마지막 결론
❌ ① replacing humans: 보조 역할이지 대체 아님
❌ ② eliminating seafood: 반대
❌ ③ chemical pesticides: 반대
det.tip: efficient(효율적인) + sustainable(지속 가능한) = AI 양식의 목표
